_comment: Maps demo concepts to model property display names. Starting guesses for Revit models: the Tech Lead confirms them in the week-1 property audit and edits this file, not the demo code.

ignore._comment: Objects left out of everything (hidden in 3D, never framed, never used for the middle of the building): not building elements, and in some models miles from the site. categories: exact Category values; categoryPattern: a regex on the Category (imported CAD shows up as a category named after the file).
